description: 100 track-L items (Logic-LM gpt-3.5-turbo / gpt-4 / text-davinci-003 outputs on FOLIO-dev) of the shared frozen NL->FOL screen, whole sentence clusters sampled with seed 0. scores = oriented metric scores (higher = more likely UNFAITHFUL); 'NA' = not applicable by design, 'FAIL' = metric failure (scored as flagged, counted against coverage).

metric_definitions.parse_fail: 1 - parses under the shared FOL grammar + z3
metric_definitions.pilot_dangling: fraction of cand symbols absent from story
metric_definitions.pilot_undeclared: fraction of cand predicates not declared (Logic-LM)
metric_definitions.judge_cheap_disg: 1 - P(faithful), primary cheap judge, DISGUISED (pre-registered bar)
metric_definitions.judge_local_qwen8b_orig: 1 - P(faithful), local Qwen3-8B JSON judge, original
metric_definitions.judge_local_qwen8b_disg: 1 - P(faithful), local Qwen3-8B JSON judge, disguised
metric_definitions.judge_local_llama8b_orig: 1 - P(YES), local Llama-3.1-8B logprob judge, original
metric_definitions.judge_local_llama8b_disg: 1 - P(YES), local Llama-3.1-8B logprob judge, disguised
metric_definitions.rt_nli_min_localverb: 1 - min NLI entail, local Qwen3-8B verbaliser

combination_feature_sets.model: L2 logistic regression C=1.0, standardised, missing -> 0 + missing-indicator, 5-fold GroupKFold by norm(text)
